What connecting your WhatsApp lets Rocoto read
where: privacy.html · What connecting your WhatsApp lets Rocoto read · <h2>

en: You connect the WhatsApp of the business you run. From then on Rocoto reads the chats where you buy and where you sell: the orders, the totals your supplier sends you, the confirmations, and the photographs of the invoices you take inside the app.
where: privacy.html · What connecting your WhatsApp lets Rocoto read ·

en: It reads them for one job: to write down each purchase and each sale, so your whole history sits in one place and leaves as a PDF whenever you ask for it.
where: privacy.html · What connecting your WhatsApp lets Rocoto read ·

en: What Rocoto keeps
Your business — its name, its WhatsApp number, and the person who connected it.
Your book — every purchase and every sale Rocoto wrote down: who, what, how much and when.
Your pictures — the invoices and receipts you photograph inside the app.
Your place on the waitlist, and the businesses you brought with you.
Who else sees it
These are the companies Rocoto runs on. Each one works under contract and on our instructions.
Meta PlatformsWhatsApp Business, the channel your chats travel on · Ireland and the United States
AnthropicReads the messages and the invoice photographs so a purchase can be written down · United States
DeepgramTurns a voice note into text · United States
SupabaseYour account and your sign-in · United States and the European Union
HetznerThe database where your book rests · Nuremberg, Germany
VercelThis website and its access logs · United States and worldwide
ResendThe emails Rocoto sends you · United States
Your book is used to run Rocoto for you. It stays with us and with the companies on this list.
Where it lives

Your book rests in the European Union, in Hetzner's data centre in Nuremberg, Germany. Some of the companies above are in the United States, and those transfers travel under the contracts Peru's rules ask for.
How long Rocoto keeps it
where: privacy.html · How long Rocoto keeps it · <h2>

en: Your book stays while you use Rocoto. When you leave, we export it for you and delete it, and what Peru's tax and accounting rules ask us to hold stays for the time they ask.
where: privacy.html · How long Rocoto keeps it ·

en: Your rights under Ley N° 29733
where: privacy.html · Your rights under Ley N° 29733 · <h2>

en: Peru's Ley N° 29733 and its reglamento give you four rights over your own data: to see it, to correct it, to have it deleted, and to object to what we do with it.
where: privacy.html · Your rights under Ley N° 29733 ·

en: Write to hello@soyrocoto.com from the number or the email you use with Rocoto, and we answer inside the time the law gives us.
where: privacy.html · Your rights under Ley N° 29733 ·

en: If our answer leaves the matter open, you can take it to the Autoridad Nacional de Protección de Datos Personales, at Peru's Ministerio de Justicia y Derechos Humanos.

What Rocoto does for your business, what you agree to, what it costs, and how you leave.
Terms
Peru · Last updated 22 September 2026
What Rocoto does today
You can join Rocoto's waitlist by connecting your business's WhatsApp. We will let you know when the services below are ready to try.
What is coming
Rocoto is preparing a simple register for counter sales and WhatsApp orders, with a record of each sale, payment and outstanding balance.
Auto-collect with Yape arrives soon, for a business that gives credit to other businesses. It is free.
The digital receipt — the boleta digital — arrives soon.

Rocoto is preparing working-capital credit for businesses like yours, with a financial institution supervised by the SBS. Businesses that already use Rocoto go first, and each business you bring moves you up the list.
What you agree to
You connect the WhatsApp of a business you run.
You keep your access to yourself, the way you keep the keys to your shop.
What you put into Rocoto is yours, and you let Rocoto read it to do the work above.
The chats Rocoto reads carry other people's names and numbers, and you stay responsible for them the way you are today.
What it costs
Joining the waitlist is free, and auto-collect with Yape is free when it arrives.
What anything else costs is agreed with you before it starts.
Early signup offer

Businesses that join the waitlist before credit launches can use the 0% interest offer on their first three loans when the service opens. Each loan is for up to S/500, with 7 days to repay. Rocoto covers the interest and fees for those seven days, so you repay the amount borrowed.
For example, borrow S/500 and repay S/500 after seven days: S/0 in interest and S/0 in fees for you. Each loan is subject to the financial institution's credit assessment and approval.

The 0% offer describes the cost to you after Rocoto covers the interest and fees. The financial institution, its contractual rates and the full credit terms are shown before you accept each loan. Credit is in preparation. We'll let you know when it is available.
How you leave
Write to hello@soyrocoto.com. We export your book for you and delete it, and what Peru's tax and accounting rules ask us to hold stays for the time they ask.
